pm_exper_user_1624_maasv_v0446_pmv2_r1.question: What are some healthy ways to calm down when I’m feeling too overwhelmed to talk?
pm_exper_user_1624_maasv_v0446_pmv2_r1.all_options:
(a) If talking feels overwhelming, try picking up your pencil and making pictures instead. Using art to show what you’re feeling can give your mind a break and help you feel ready to share later.
(b) When you’re feeling too overwhelmed to talk, you might sit somewhere quiet and start drawing, just like you do when you need to get your feelings out. Later, enjoying a little lumpia snack could add some comfort and make it easier to face conversations again.
(c) When you’re feeling too overwhelmed to talk, try finding a calm spot and doing something relaxing, like listening to music or taking deep breaths. Giving yourself space for a few minutes can help you feel ready to speak again.
(d) When words feel stuck, you can grab your sketchbook and draw whatever is in your mind until the tension eases. Letting your feelings come out through your drawings can help you feel calmer before you try speaking again.
